description_en: Queries the sub-interfaces of a dedicated connection port by calling DescribeSagExpressConnectInterfaceList
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-express-connect-interface-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --port-name 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSagExpressConnectInterfaceList

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and the corresponding region IDs

TaskStates.description_en: The status of the query task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the query task was created

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. 200 indicates that the query task succeeded
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. "Successful" indicates that the query task succeeded
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

Initialized: The query task is initialized.
Offline: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will be delivered after the device comes online.
Succeed: The query task is delivered.
Processing: The query task is being delivered.
VersionNotSupport: The current version of the Smart Access Gateway device does not support this operation.
BuildRequestError: The China Cloud Management Platform does not support this operation.
HardwareError: The query task failed to be delivered due to a device error.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will not be delivered even after the device comes online
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
